segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the renewal and the added calibration module for the new lines before we send the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re at 42 seats today, and we need 8 more for the second shift supervisors. Go-live for them is April 15 if we can keep training the week before.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, 50 seats total, calibration module for Lines 3 and 4, and training on April 8 and 10. I have that in the quote notes already.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. What’s the annual number coming out to?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: For the 50 seats and module, it’s $38,400 for the year. Same net 30 terms, invoice on the renewal start date, which is May 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That lines up. Can you split the invoice by department? 70 percent operations, 30 percent quality.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, we can do that. I’ll mark the billing split on the order form so the invoice shows both cost centers: 4100 for ops and 4200 for quality.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Legal asked if the auto-renew language is still 30 days’ notice.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It is. The term is May 1, 2026 through April 30, 2027, and either side can give notice 30 days before the end. No other contract changes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Alright, send it over today and I’ll route it to our controller. If she signs by Friday, are we still okay for April training?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. If we have signature by March 22, we’ll hold the April 8 and 10 sessions. I’ll send the order form in about an hour.
